visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with a fair complexion and light makeup is seen in a medium close-up, facing the camera. She has long hair intricately braided into numerous small, tight braids, adorned with several small, colorful hair clips in shades of red, yellow, and green. She wears a light blue t-shirt with a cartoon hedgehog graphic. Behind her is a soft, light-colored couch with red and yellow plush toys. The lighting is bright and even, typical of indoor studio or home setups. (2) The scene shifts to a montage of her removing the clips and unbraiding her hair. Close-up shots show her fingers meticulously unclipping the plastic accessories and untying the elastic bands. She holds up small bunches of hair, revealing that she has used silvery-white and dark brown synthetic hair extensions blended into her natural hair. Her facial expressions vary from focused to amused as she pulls out long strands. (3) A medium shot shows her pulling out large clumps of the synthetic extensions. She holds them out toward the camera, demonstrating the significant volume of hair being removed. The background remains the same living room setting. The editing uses fast jump cuts to show the progression. (4) As the unbraiding continues, she starts to gather a large pile of removed hair on her lap or the couch beside her. She looks at the camera and gestures toward the ever-growing mound of synthetic fiber. She continues to remove the last few braids from the back of her head, leaning forward to reach them. (5) In the final phase, she has removed all the extensions and clips. Her natural hair is loose, appearing very wavy and crimped from being in braids. She runs her hands through her hair to loosen the waves and poses with a satisfied, slightly tired smile. The lighting remains bright, and she remains centered in the frame.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a female voice speaking clearly in Traditional Chinese with a friendly, conversational tone. A cheerful, mid-tempo pop BGM with electronic synthesizers and a steady drum beat plays in the background. (2) A sharp 'pop' SFX is heard simultaneously with the removal of a hair clip on screen. Hannah continues her narration, her pitch rising as she expresses curiosity about what content to film next. (3) The BGM transitions to a more upbeat song featuring a male vocal singer. High-pitched 'ding' SFX are triggered as variety-show style text captions appear on the screen. (4) A loud, sharp sneeze occurs, followed immediately by Hannah saying 'Bless you' in a playful, lower pitch. The music continues uninterrupted. (5) As the unbraiding montage accelerates, several rapid 'whoosh' and 'swish' SFX are used to emphasize the quick transitions between shots. The sound of hair extensions rustling against her clothing is faintly audible. (6) In the final phase, the female narrator speaks more quickly, reflecting on the time spent braiding her hair. The audio ends with a bright musical flourish and her final comment on the complexity of women, followed by a playful exclamation.

narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Montage: Introduction -> Step-by-step process -> Climax (showing the pile of hair) -> Final Result.
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: A personal lifestyle vlog documenting the lengthy and somewhat tedious process of unbraiding hair and removing numerous synthetic extensions after a professional hosting event. It emphasizes the contrast between the elaborate initial look and the simpler natural hair result.
